targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, concat(symbol, '.', venue) AS instrument, avg(price) AS price FROM market.trade WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) AND symbol LIKE 'BTC%' GROUP BY time, instrument ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, concat(symbol, '.', venue) AS instrument, avg(price) AS price FROM market.trade WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) AND symbol LIKE 'ETH%' GROUP BY time, instrument ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, concat(symbol, '.', venue) AS instrument, count() / $__interval_s AS trades FROM market.trade WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) GROUP BY time, instrument ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, concat(symbol, '.', venue) AS instrument, avg((ask_price - bid_price) / ((ask_price + bid_price) / 2)) * 10000 AS spread_bps FROM market.quote WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) GROUP BY time, instrument ORDER BY time

panels.title: Bybit mark price vs last trade (bps)

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.time AS time, m.symbol AS symbol, (t.price - m.mark) / m.mark * 10000 AS basis_bps FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, symbol, avg(price) AS mark FROM market.mark_price WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) GROUP BY time, symbol) AS m INNER JOIN (SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, symbol, avg(price) AS price FROM market.trade WHERE venue = 'BYBIT' AND $__timeFilter(ts_event) GROUP BY time, symbol) AS t ON m.time = t.time AND m.symbol = t.symbol ORDER BY time

SELECT symbol, venue, argMax(rate, ts_event) AS rate, argMax(interval_minutes, ts_event) AS interval_minutes, argMax(next_funding_ts, ts_event) AS next_funding, max(ts_event) AS updated FROM market.funding_rate GROUP BY symbol, venue ORDER BY symbol

panels.title: Order book: best bid / ask (book_snapshot)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, concat(symbol, '.', venue) AS instrument, avg(bids.price[1]) AS best_bid, avg(asks.price[1]) AS best_ask FROM market.book_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) AND symbol LIKE 'BTC%' GROUP BY time, instrument ORDER BY time

panels.description: book_snapshot is a dynamic table that starts disabled. Set `enabled: true` for it in config/tables.yaml and rows appear here within seconds.

panels.title: Order book: top-10 depth (book_snapshot)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, concat(symbol, '.', venue) AS instrument, avg(arraySum(bids.size)) AS bid_depth, avg(arraySum(asks.size)) AS ask_depth FROM market.book_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) AND symbol LIKE 'BTC%' GROUP BY time, instrument ORDER BY time

panels.description: Sum of size over the 10 levels recorded per side.
